stem_book: A uniform square plate of side 2 m and mass 6 kg lies in a horizontal plane. An axis passes through the centre of the plate and lies in its plane, making an angle 30° with one of its sides. Find the moment of inertia of the plate about this axis. (a) 2 kg m² (b) 3 kg m² (c) 4 kg m² (d) 5 kg m²
reason: Options printed in 'kg/m²' — unit misprint corrected to kg m².
work: Any in-plane axis through centre of a square: I = Ma²/12 = 6(2)²/12 = 2 kg m²
